Though, you hadnt met one of the turtles, who happened to be raphael. The three turtles, Mikey, Leo and Donnie are in your room, ensuring your care, until Rafael arrives.*

“uh..” *raphael stared at the human* “what is she doing here?” *he asks his brothers.*
